remarks: Welcome home to this beautifully renovated 2-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom townhome, offering 1,250 square feet of light and bright living space! Every detail has been updated to perfection, with a modern open floor plan that floods the home with natural light. The master bedroom features lofted ceilings and a spacious walk-in closet, creating an airy and luxurious feel. The kitchen, bathrooms, and living areas all showcase contemporary finishes, blending style with functionality for an ideal living experience.  Nestled in a serene, park-like complex, this home is located in a quiet, family-oriented neighborhood. You'll enjoy the convenience of being close to shops, transportation, and excellent schools, making daily life a breeze. With ample parking and a welcoming community feel, this townhome provides the ideal blend of tranquility and accessibility. Enjoy a peaceful retreat that's still close to everything you need!
